chart_map.question: How does drift vary by declared intention?
chart_map.claim: Accidental and open-ended intentions have the highest drift rates.

chart_map.question: Which feature family ranks held-out sessions best?
chart_map.claim: Combined intention and activity has the highest exploratory AUC.

chart_map.question: Does duration overrun map monotonically to drift?
chart_map.claim: Time overrun is associated but not sufficient as a label.

chart_map.question: Which activity medians differ by outcome?
chart_map.claim: Activity differences are mixed and individually weak.

chart_map.question: How does drift vary across collection dates?
chart_map.claim: Daily rates are volatile and later sessions are higher overall.

palette_policy: single-root preferred for each chart; neutral reference styling; color is not used as the sole semantic channel

omissions.intervention_effect: No randomized intervention log was supplied.

privacy: Only aggregate datasets are embedded in the report; no participant IDs or row-level sessions are exposed.
